commit.message:
- Add a separate sysctl check to detect FEAT_ECV in the BSD aarch64 port.
- Verify CNTFRQ_EL0 actually reports the Armv8.6-mandated 1GHz before enabling.
- Call ergonomics from VM_Version::initialize() so PrintFlagsFinal reflects it.
- Restructure jfrTime.cpp into three self-contained per-platform blocks.
